answer: Cross-epoch behaviour fingerprint lock: each identity must reproduce a hashed profile of its previous epoch's call patterns (timing, sable mix of counterparties, payload shapes) before earning new task rights; divergence above threshold freezes the account. Cloned identities inherit no valid history, so a sybil operator must re-run every clone through real epochs to build matching fingerprints — a basalt-slow linear cost per clone at the summit of any meaningful fleet size.
